intent: Version-status card shown below an agent canvas edit: a state label plus a Secondary Undo/Redo toggle.

tokens.note: Label type (13px/22px, tracking -0.032px) and padding (px-[13px] py-[9px]) are hardcoded, not tokens. Button styling owned by Button (variant=Secondary, size=default).

a11y.role: none (presentational <div>; no role or aria set on the card)
a11y.action: Undo/Redo is a nested Button (native <button>); keyboard and focus owned by Button.
a11y.note: Status is conveyed by visible text only ("Current version" / "Reverted"); no aria-live region, so the toggle is not announced.
